command:
set -u
ROOT=/workspace/omega_runtime
REL=$(readlink -f "$ROOT/current")
printf '%s\n' '---CURRENT_RELEASE---'
cat "$ROOT/CURRENT_RELEASE.json" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---COMPOSED_RELEASE---'
cat "$REL/OMEGA_COMPOSED_RELEASE.json" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---ACTIVATION_RECEIPT---'
cat "$ROOT/activation_receipts/777-a676-pre.json" 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---CARRIER GIT---'
git -C "$ROOT/carrier_repo" status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$ROOT/carrier_repo" remote -v 2>/dev/null || true
git -C "$ROOT/carrier_repo" log --all --oneline --decorate -20 -- omega_deploy/a676258885b964efc2a80599957dc1c09dc3d43b 2>/dev/null || true
printf '%s\n' '---ACTIVATION PRIMITIVES---'
grep -Rsn --exclude='*.pyc' --exclude-dir='.git' -E 'CURRENT_RELEASE\.json|ln -s(fn|f|n).*omega_runtime/current|activation_receipts|OMEGA_COMPOSED_RELEASE' "$ROOT/carrier_repo" "$ROOT" 2>/dev/null | head -300 || true
